mentions.name: The Daily Baffle
mentions.description: A daily puzzle site featuring a collection of original word and logic puzzles, including Truthsorting (a logic puzzle where you order logical statements so they evaluate true or false), Pathword (laying out letters along a path to spell out four words), and Morphology (a clued word ladder contributed by a different writer daily), plus several other puzzles.
mentions.problem: After a few months of promotion, the audience has stalled around 500 people and growth has been challenging.
mentions.audience: Around 500 people; growing beyond that has been challenging.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built The Daily Baffle over at https://dailybaffle.com with a whole bunch of word and logic puzzles I designed.
